suggestions.change: Find and fix the root cause of the recurring ~03:30 failure, or add a bot retry that checks again before it posts. Alert only if the retry fails. Also merge the night, ring, fixed, quiet and deduped entries into one episode per day.
suggestions.why: It failed 2 of 7 runs, but the ledger shows night items on 11-10, 11-11, 11-13 and 11-15 plus a ring at 07:21 on almost every one of those mornings. The same problem rings him again and again, and it is fixed by itself each time. The 11-15 one is still open.

suggestions.change: Do not ring at 07:21 when the failure already has a night item and nothing has changed. Ring only if the check is still failing after a retry, or if it has been open longer than a set time.
suggestions.why: A ring follows the night item at 07:21 on 11-10, 11-11, 11-13 and 11-15. The 11-12 night item was fixed by 03:28 with no ring, so the ring adds nothing new.

suggestions.change: Treat truth:recalls and recalls as one episode with one key. Send the day-level alert only if the fix fails.
suggestions.why: On 11-08 recalls was fixed at 11:30, truth:recalls was deduped at 11:58 and fixed at 20:42. It is the same episode reported on two keys.

suggestions.change: Keep it at summary and collapse it into one open episode that closes with a single fixed. Alternatively, find out why it keeps slowing down and fix that.
suggestions.why: It shows up on 11-09, 11-10, 11-11, 11-13, 11-14 and 11-15, mostly as quiet or deduped entries, and it is fixed and then returns each time. It never needs him.

suggestions.change: Lower these to summary, or merge them into one entry per post batch. Only a failed post should stay at day level.
suggestions.why: Every story, carousel, reel and post has its own day-level 'done' entry, and about 20 of them sit open since late October. They are just confirmations.

suggestions.change: Auto-close these done notices when the next state arrives (sent then live then full), and drop them to summary. Close the old open ones from 10-25 to 11-07.
suggestions.why: About 12 of these are still open weeks later, although they only report that something finished, and nothing is waiting on him.

suggestions.change: Replace each daily key with one rolling entry per kind that is updated and closed when the next one arrives. Close the old open entries.
suggestions.why: seo:daily has been open since 11-04 and is queued every day. The copy, stl and catalog entries pile up with no action needed from him.
